title: Crown with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- Crown base -->
  <rect x='20' y='62' width='60' height='20' rx='4' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Crown base highlight -->
  <rect x='22' y='64' width='56' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFE84D'/>
  <!-- Crown base darker bottom -->
  <rect x='20' y='76' width='60' height='6' rx='2' fill='#E0B800'/>
  <!-- Crown points -->
  <polygon points='20,62 20,25 32,42 42,20 50,40 58,20 68,42 80,25 80,62' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Point highlights -->
  <polygon points='20,62 20,30 30,44 38,26 44,42' fill='#FFE84D' opacity='0.5'/>
  <polygon points='80,62 80,30 70,44 62,26 56,42' fill='#FFE84D' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Center point highlight -->
  <polygon points='44,42 50,24 56,42' fill='#FFE84D' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Gems on points -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='27' r='4' fill='#FF4444'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='22' r='4' fill='#44AAFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='22' r='4' fill='#44AAFF'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='27' r='4' fill='#FF4444'/>
  <!-- Center gem -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='5' fill='#00DD88'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='3' fill='#88FFCC'/>
  <!-- Smiling face on base -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='70' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#222255'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='70' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#222255'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#AADDFF'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#AADDFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M40,76 Q50,84 60,76' stroke='#222255' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='75' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='75' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
